title: Breathing and Respiration
summary: How the diaphragm and ribs move air in and out, how exercise changes breathing, and how cells release energy from glucose.

ib.note: Aerobic and anaerobic respiration equations follow in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 9: Life Processes in Animals
Earlier NCERT Ch 10: Respiration in Organisms

objectives: I can describe how breathing in and out happens, using the diaphragm and ribs.
I can distinguish breathing (moving air) from respiration (releasing energy in cells).
I can show that exhaled air contains more carbon dioxide.
misconceptions: Breathing and respiration are the same thing.
We breathe in oxygen and breathe out only carbon dioxide.
Lungs are muscles that pump air.
